useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

targetOutputMapping.description:
This field maps the `targetOutput` input of {@link #scoringMetric} to the `targetOutput` input of this metric.
If the `targetOutput` input for {@link #scoringMetric} is single-input, then this field should be a `string` that
matches one of the keys in the `targetOutput` input to this metric.
If the `targetOutput` input for {@link #scoringMetric} is multi-input, then this field maps the keys of the
`targetOutput` input of {@link #scoringMetric} to the keys of the `targetOutput` input of this metric.

modelOutputMapping.description:
This field maps the `modelOutput` input of {@link #scoringMetric} to the `modelOutput` input of this metric.
If the `modelOutput` input for {@link #scoringMetric} is single-input, then this field should be a `string` that
matches one of the keys in the `modelOutput` input to this metric.
If the `modelOutput` input for {@link #scoringMetric} is multi-input, then this field maps the keys of the
`modelOutput` input of {@link #scoringMetric} to the keys of the `modelOutput` input of this metric.

contextMapping.description: This field maps the `context` input of {@link #scoringMetric} to the `context` input of this metric.
